messages.subject: For Beata Jurkschat | Corporate affairs, ESG and international mining execution
messages.body:
Dear KGHM ESG Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Beata Jurkschat, Vice President of the Management Board for Corporate Affairs.

KGHM's international mining portfolio requires disciplined coordination across government, regulators, communities, sustainability commitments and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead institutional engagement, coordinate complex regulatory and stakeholder matters across operating functions, and translate external commitments into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support KGHM's corporate-affairs, ESG, government-relations or international stakeholder priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to KGHM.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
